description: Failing-first test specifications for the recurring defect classes of Rehearsals 1-3 (R4-01: they become tests before the first write code). Each is written against the application's F# engine and providers in the rehearsal repository; 'task' is where it must exist and fail before the fix exists. Levels follow PF-011: domain, fixture, conformance (recorded real responses), live (real GitHub test repository), browser.

tests.invariant: A publication is parented by the exact commit its decision was read at; it never fast-forwards over history it did not read.
tests.given: A decision read at commit A; another writer advanced the branch to B, changing the same investigation
tests.then: The publication is refused as a conflict (non-fast-forward), the other writer's events remain, and the local change is kept pending
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

tests.invariant: Reconciliation compares commits by ancestry, never by ref equality.
tests.given: A remote head that descends from the local base through another writer's commit
tests.when: The provider reconciles after a reload
tests.then: The change is classified as concurrent, not as already applied
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

tests.invariant: A provider answer applies only to the request instance (generation) that asked it, and only while that write is still in flight.
tests.given: Write W1 in flight; W1 is replaced by W2 before W1's answers arrive
tests.when: A late answer for W1 arrives
tests.then: It is discarded; W2's state and published bytes are unaffected
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

citations.quote: Typed request book: a response applies only to its own request (DC-002)

tests.invariant: Every user event is legal only in its source states (write from Idle/Held, reapply from Idle, discard from Held, connect from Disconnected/Refused); a resubmitted unchanged command keeps its target (R3 D-04).
tests.given: Each event delivered in every state of the sync machine
tests.then: Events outside their legal states are refused with a typed fault and change nothing
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

tests.invariant: Once the publication request has been sent, any failure (network error, cancellation, read-back mismatch) is 'unknown', never 'not written'.
tests.given: A write whose publication was sent and whose response was lost
tests.then: State is unknown (may have applied): no Retry is offered, reconciliation re-reads the head first
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

citations.quote: Pending, sending, conflicted and unknown remain distinct states.

tests.invariant: Advisory provider fields never authorize: an absent permissions/role field is not denial; only GitHub's answer to the write decides.
tests.given: A repository response without a permissions field (installation or fine-grained token), recorded from the real API
tests.when: The workspace computes whether saving is offered
tests.then: Saving is offered; a refused write is held as write-denied with a renewable credential
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

tests.invariant: Reads of mutable state (refs, repository) are never answerable from any cache; content-addressed reads may be cached.
tests.given: GitHub answers with Cache-Control: private, max-age=60
tests.when: The branch head is re-read after a write and after a page reload
tests.then: Every mutable read has a URL unique across sessions and page loads; the new head is observed
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

tests.invariant: A failed framework download ends the start promptly with the recoverable failure, and Retry reaches ready.
tests.then: The recoverable failure is shown well before the start timeout, focus is on Retry, and Retry loads to ready
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

tests.invariant: Editable bound inputs declare data-on="input" so a projection never overwrites typed text.
tests.given: A user typing in a bound field while a projection arrives

tests.invariant: Create, write, reload, conflict (expected-version mismatch) and rejected token behave as specified against the real test repository, with independent SHA re-reads.
tests.given: The write-capable test repository and CAUSA_GITHUB_TOKEN (T05)
tests.when: The live job runs at the first persistence checkpoint
tests.then: All five scenarios pass; evidence records run id and commit SHAs; no token appears in any artifact (R3 N1)
tests.reuse: none: rehearsal code, tests and reproductions are not inputs (PERSIST-026); the test is written from the stated invariant

citations.quote: They run against the real GitHub test repository: create, write, reload, conflict (expected-version mismatch), rejected token.
